detailEn: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur sets goal for Azerbaijan GP as Nico Rosberg pinpoints team's 'Achilles' heel'

Ferrari have scored only one podium finish in the last five races in major blow to their championship aspirations despite consistent flashes of promising pace; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm
Nico Rosberg discusses what went wrong for Ferrari on a messy weekend at the Spanish Grand Prix.
Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur has stressed the importance of executing weekends more cleanly after a costly run of results for the team at recent races.

Since winning the British Grand Prix at the start of July, their second win in the space of three races, Ferrari have seen their challenge in both championship battles fade with Charles Leclerc's second place in Belgium before the summer break their only podium finish from the last five rounds.

That is despite the SF-26 continuing to look competitive at different stages of race weekends, most recently in Madrid when Lewis Hamilton held provisional pole after the first runs of Q3 only to end up fourth on the grid.

And heading to a wall-lined Baku street circuit at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix this weekend where driver momentum is key and mistakes are regularly punished, Vasseur says Ferrari must be at the top of their game.

"The last few races have demonstrated that our car can deliver a good level of competitiveness, but they have also highlighted how important it is to put every part of the weekend together," said the Ferrari team principal.
"Baku is a very specific challenge, where confidence in the car and execution are particularly important.
"It is also a circuit where the weekend can throw up several variables, so we need to stay focused on ourselves, adapt to whatever situations arise and make the most of every opportunity."
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!
'They're just not putting it together properly' - Rosberg pinpoints Ferrari's problem
Ferrari's recent lack of podiums mean the team's hopes of ending what stands as a 18-year world title drought look increasingly remote this season.

Lead scorer Hamilton slipped over 100 points behind Kimi Antonelli for the first time after retiring from the Madrid race with brake problems, while Ferrari are now 145 points behind Mercedes in the Constructors' Championship.
Lewis Hamilton explains what might have caused his early retirement at the Spanish Grand Prix.
Third-placed McLaren have outscored Ferrari at each of the last four rounds to close to within 52 points of the Scuderia with a scheduled nine rounds left.

Speaking on The F1 Show podcast, Sky Sports F1 pundit Nico Rosberg said Ferrari were consistently "very close" to the leading pace but that their execution of race weekends continued to let them down.
"Isn't it the case that Ferrari always have messy weekends?" asked the 2016 world champion.
"It's just that Achilles' heel is still in the strategy area, communication area. That's always been a weakness and still is a weakness of theirs now.

"They're very close. They're just not putting it together properly. And they really need to somehow make progress on that. That's the main problem they're facing."

哈斯车队两位车手都仍然与法拉利车队有联系，并保留着未来为意大利车队驾驶的愿望，这进一步加强了两支车队之间牢固的合作关系，法拉利车队还为哈斯车队提供动力单元和其他重要部件。
当被问及卡马拉的签约是否会改变哈斯车队的形象时，小松回答说：“不，说实话，我们与法拉利的合作让我们能够接触到那些法拉利学院的车手。”
拉斐尔·卡马拉与哈斯车队签订了多年合约，作为奥康的替代者。
所以，奥利·贝尔曼，由于我们与法拉利的合作关系，我们有机会在墨西哥（2024年）测试他。
然后，由于我们有了这种关系，我们有机会在波尔蒂马奥测试拉斐尔。
但这也和当初我们选择奥利一样。法拉利从未向我们施压，'哦，阿亚奥，你能带奥利吗？因为他是一名FDA车手，他需要一个赛车席位，或者你能带拉斐尔吗？因为他即将赢得F2，他真的很需要进入一级方程式？'
“都不是。我们完全是自己选择车手，我自己和（车队老板）Gene 哈斯先生一起选择。”
“所以，是的，他们是FDA车手，他们的职业生涯得到了法拉利的支持，但他们是我们哈斯 F1车队的车手，我们没有义务或压力从法拉利那里带走任何人。”
“所以那个法拉利B队的事情甚至都不值得一提。”
为未来法拉利的一个席位而战？
Komatsu还坚称，他并不担心贝尔曼和Camara为了给法拉利留下深刻印象而可能发生的激烈竞争会变成哈斯的问题。
尽管查尔斯·勒克莱尔今年早些时候与法拉利签订了多年合同延期，但他的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在F1中还能继续多少年仍是个未知数。
这位七届世界冠军将在一月份满42岁，而他的法拉利合同是否延续到2027赛季结束之后还不明确。
奥利·贝尔曼在驾驶艾尔顿·塞纳1985年的Lotus 97T赛车后，忍不住流下了眼泪，这辆赛车是塞纳首次赢得一级方程式赛车胜利的赛车。
每当法拉利需要一位新车手时，贝尔曼和Camara将是明显的竞争者，这意味着他们在哈斯车队的表现可能会成为他们一级方程式未来的决定性因素。
"一级方程式作为一个整体，是一场巨大的竞争，"Komatsu说。"所以，你的第一个目标是击败你的队友。
"但我认为他们都会非常专注于如何发挥出自己的最佳水平。
"因为，再次强调，体育成绩，击败别人，并不完全在你自己的控制之中。你可能正在发挥出你最好的驾驶水平，但别人可能比你开得更好，在这种情况下，你可能会被击败。"
“但这不是你可以控制的事情。你可以控制的是，从自己、从团队那里榨取最好的东西，绝对的一切。我相信这正是那两个家伙将要专注的事情。”
“那两个家伙，拉法和奥利，他们都非常快。”

detailEn: Haas boss Ayao Komatsu dismisses 'Ferrari B-team' label following signing of second academy driver Rafael Camara

Haas have announced the signing of Ferrari Academy driver Rafael Camara for the 2027 season; Camara is set to drive alongside fellow Ferrari product Oliver Bearman; watch every session of the United States GP in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
Ayao Komatsu denies Haas are a Ferrari B team after Ferrari junior driver Rafael Camara signs alongside Ollie Bearman.
Haas boss Ayao Komatsu has dismissed the suggestion that his squad have become a "Ferrari B-team" after they confirmed the signing of a second driver from the Italian outfit's academy.
Haas announced on Thursday that 21-year-old Brazilian Rafael Camara will drive for them in 2027 after signing a multi-year contract.
Camara is set to drive alongside fellow Ferrari Driver Academy (FDA) product Oliver Bearman, with confirmation that the Brit will remain with Haas for a third season expected soon.

Haas' pairing of the two drivers, who both remain attached to Ferrari and retain ambitions of driving for the Italian team in future, furthers a strong working relationship between the two squads that also sees Ferrari supply Haas with power units and other significant parts.
Asked whether the signing of Camara could alter perceptions of Haas' identity, Komatsu said: "No, honestly, our collaboration with Ferrari gives us the access to those Ferrari Academy drivers.
Rafael Camara has signed a multi-year deal with Haas as Esteban Ocon's replacement.
"So, Ollie Bearman, because of our relationship with Ferrari, we had a chance to test him in Mexico (in 2024).
"And then because we got this relationship, we had a chance to test Rafa in Portimao.

"But it's the same as when we took Ollie. At no point Ferrari pressurised us, 'oh, Ayao, can you take Ollie because he's an FDA driver, he needs a race seat, or can you take Rafa because he's going to win F2 and he really needs to be in Formula 1?'
"None of that. We choose drivers by ourselves completely, by myself and (team owner) Mr Gene Haas.
"So, yes, they are FDA drivers, their careers have been supported by Ferrari, but they are Haas F1 team drivers and we are under no obligation or pressure to take anyone from Ferrari.
"So that Ferrari B-team thing is just not even a starter."
A battle for a future Ferrari seat?
Komatsu also insists he has no concerns that a potentially intense contest between Bearman and Camara to impress Ferrari could become a problem for Haas.
While Charles Leclerc signed a multi-year contract extension with Ferrari earlier this year, it remains to be seen how many more years his team-mate Lewis Hamilton will continue in F1.
The seven-time world champion will turn 42 in January, while it's unclear whether his Ferrari contract stretches beyond the end of the 2027 season.
Ollie Bearman is reduced to tears after driving Ayrton Senna's 1985 Lotus 97T, the car Senna drove to his first-ever Formula 1 victory.
Whenever Ferrari do require a new driver, Bearman and Camara would be obvious contenders, which means the way things play out for them at Haas could be a decisive factor in their F1 futures.
"Formula 1, as a whole, is a huge competition," Komatsu said. "So, a team-mate is the first person you need to beat.
"But both of them, I think they will be really focused on how to get the best out of themselves.

"Because, again, sporting results, beating somebody else, it's not totally under your control. You could be having your best drive, but somebody else can out-drive you, and in the circumstances, you might get beaten.

"But that's not something you can control. What you can control is to get the best out of yourself, absolutely everything, from your team, from yourself. And I believe that's what both of those guys are going to be focused on.
"And both of those guys, both Rafa and Ollie, they are incredibly quick."

detailZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫在新加坡大奖赛“不寻常”的规格分歧后，透露了对赛车升级的最新评估。
基米·安东内利在新加坡驾驶了梅赛德斯的升级版赛车，而乔治·拉塞尔在车队马来西亚出现问题后换回了旧版赛车；沃尔夫认为两位车手在下一场比赛中都可能使用新规格赛车；请于10月23日至25日在天空体育F1观看美国大奖赛的每节练习与排位。
乔治·拉塞尔在新加坡冲刺赛因雨延迟期间，接替基米·安东内利的工程师，恶作剧了他的队友！
托托·沃尔夫表示，梅赛德斯需要全面了解近期升级的潜力，这对2027年赛车的开发“至关重要”，此前新加坡大奖赛是“朝着正确方向迈出的一步”。
梅赛德斯采取了沃尔夫承认的“不寻常”做法，在上一场比赛中使用了两种不同的赛车规格，此前在上一站马来西亚为两辆W17引入的重大升级遇到了问题，这是这位世界冠军领跑者自五月以来的首次重大升级。
基米·安东内利在新加坡使用了更新的规格，而乔治·拉塞尔则换回了旧套件，在那个周末他已经知道自己将因引擎处罚而从大奖赛发车格的后排起步。
基米·安东内利如何最早在下一场比赛就赢得F1世界冠军

使用旧版套件的拉塞尔在最初的冲刺赛各节练习与排位中证明是两位车手中更快的一位，随后使用新版套件的安东内利在主要排位赛中更快，之后在大奖赛中获得第三名，向赢得世界冠军迈出了重要一步。
安东内利赛后表示有信心，“我们开始看到隧道尽头的曙光”。
回顾周末结束时的分车测试计划，梅赛德斯车队负责人沃尔夫表示：“我们在这家尖端技术企业里采取了不同寻常的举措，让两辆赛车采用不同配置，因为我们认为需要加速学习曲线，这很好。
“从根本上说，回顾这场比赛，我认为这辆新车需要与上一辆车截然不同的调校理念。这就是我们目前正在学习的东西。
2026年新加坡大奖赛的精彩集锦。
“它像上一辆车那样容易驾驶吗？我不这么认为。它是否具备我们希望升级能带来的性能？我认为目前还没有。但这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。
“在奥斯汀，我们应该看看能否继续巩固这一点，以及它是否还有更多性能，因为这对明年的研发方向至关重要。”
梅赛德斯还在新加坡冲刺赛周末开始时，为安东内利的赛车加装了新的前翼套件，不过在唯一一节练习赛后就被拆下了。
梅赛德斯很可能在奥斯汀为两辆赛车都使用最新套件
沃尔夫补充说，他预计两辆赛车都将在下周的美国大奖赛上使用更新的规格，但最终决定要等车队在奥斯汀之前做出。
“最新的情况是，我们可能想在奥斯汀启用新部件，”他说。
“两位车手都认为这在奥斯汀应该会产生积极效果，或者说应该会有好处，而且我认为就我们为明年学习而言，这是正确的方向。
托托·沃尔夫回击了有关梅赛德斯偏爱基米·安东内利而非乔治·拉塞尔的指责。
“再次说明，我之前就说过，等明天（比赛后的周一）那些聪明人聚在一起之后，以及明天之后，我们会看看我们想要推进的下一个版本会是什么。”

detailEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff reveals latest verdict on car upgrades after 'unusual' specification split at Singapore GP

Kimi Antonelli ran Mercedes' upgraded car in Singapore while George Russell reverted to old one after team's Malaysia issues; Wolff thinks both drivers likely to use new-spec at next race; watch every session of the United States GP on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
George Russell took over from Kimi Antonelli's engineer during the Sprint rain delay in Singapore to prank his team-mate!

Toto Wolff says it is "crucial" for the development of Mercedes' 2027 car that they understand the full extent of their recent upgrade's potential after a "step in the right direction" at the Singapore Grand Prix.

Mercedes took what Wolff admitted was the "unusual" step of running two different car specifications at the last race after troubles with the big car upgrade introduced onto both W17s at the previous round in Malaysia, the world championship leader's first major upgrade since May.

Kimi Antonelli ran the newer spec in Singapore, while George Russell reverted to the older package on a weekend he already knew he would start at the back of the Grand Prix grid owing to engine penalties.

Russell with the older package proved the quicker of the two drivers in the initial Sprint sessions before Antonelli, with the newer package, was then faster in main qualifying before finishing third in the Grand Prix, moving a significant step closer to winning the world title.
Antonelli expressed confidence afterwards that "we started to see the light at the end of the tunnel".

Reflecting on the split programme at the end of the weekend, Mercedes team principal Wolff said: "We made the unusual move in a cutting-edge technology business to have two different cars because we felt we need to accelerate our learning curve and that was good.
"Fundamentally, looking back at the race, I think that this new car needs a very different set-up philosophy than the previous car. This is what we're learning at the moment.
Highlights from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix.

"Was it an easy car like the previous one? I don't think it was. Does it have the performance that we were hoping the upgrade would bring? I don't think so yet. But it was a step in the right direction.
"In Austin, we should see whether we can continue to consolidate that and whether it has more performance because it's crucial for the development direction for the next year."
Mercedes also added a new front wing to package on Antonelli's car at the start of the Singapore Sprint weekend, although this was taken off after the sole practice session.
Mercedes likely to run both cars with latest package in Austin
Wolff added that he expected that both cars would run the newer specification at next week's United States Grand Prix, pending a final decision by the team before Austin.
"The latest is that we probably want to run the new cars in Austin," he said.
"Both drivers think it should have a positive effect, or it should have a benefit, in Austin, and I think in terms of us learning for next year this is the right direction to go.
Toto Wolff hits back at accusations that Mercedes favour Kimi Antonelli over George Russell.
"Again, I'm saying before the clever groups have come together tomorrow [on Monday after the race] and after tomorrow, we'll see what the next iteration will be we want to go."
